map.AA制账单分摊计算器 使用指南: AA bill splitting calculator user guide
map.→ 打开AA制账单分摊计算器工具: -> Open the AA bill splitting calculator tool
map.可设免单人，余额由其余均摊。: You can mark one person exempt, and the remainder is split equally among the rest.
map.合租水电费按各房间人数分摊，设置每人份数后自动得到各自应付。: Shared-flat utilities are split by the number of people in each room; set each share to get everyone amount due automatically.
map.含小费总额 = 总金额 × (1 + 小费% ÷ 100)；每人应付 = 含小费: Total with tip = amount x (1 + tip% / 100); each person pays = total with tip x that person share / total shares
map.多人聚餐或活动费用分摊，支持等额AA、按人数比例分摊、逐项明细与小费计算，自动汇: Splitting costs for group dinners or events, supporting equal AA split, per-head ratio split, itemized details and tip calculation, automatically totalling what each person owes to settle group bills.
map.小费是按总额还是按人头加？: Is the tip added on the total or per person?
map.按整单总额的百分比计入后再拆分，等效于每人按自身份数占比承担同比例小费。: Adding it as a percentage of the whole bill and then splitting it is equivalent to each person paying that same share of the tip according to their own portion.
map.支持等额 AA 与按份数分摊两种模式。小费按整单百分比计，先并入总额再按各自份数: Supports equal AA and share-weighted splitting. The tip is a percentage of the whole bill, added into the total first and then divided by each person share; in itemized mode each expense line assigns its own participants, and each person total is then summed.
map.聚餐/合租平摊含小费。: Split restaurant bills or shared-flat costs including the tip.
map.：总 300 元、3 人、含 10% 小费 → 每人 (300×1.1)/3=1: : a total of 300 CNY for 3 people with a 10% tip gives (300 x 1.1)/3 = 110 CNY each.
